description: Dashboard key management + UI + developer docs + scratchpad. Adds the session-guarded management routes (GET/POST /api/api-keys, DELETE /api/api-keys/[id]), a mobile-responsive management page at /dashboard/api-keys with a sidebar link, the developer-docs M2M section (and correction of the stale 'no programmatic API-key scheme' note), and the scratchpad update with a dated Change log entry. Depends on FEAT-001 (ApiKey model + generateApiKey) and benefits from FEAT-002 being present so the docs describe real /api/v1 behavior.
steps: Create src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts per design.md §6.1-§6.2: GET session-guarded (getServerSession(authOptions), 401 if no session.user.id) returns prisma.apiKey.findMany({where:{userId:session.user.id}, select:{id:true,name:true,keyPrefix:true,lastUsedAt:true,revokedAt:true,createdAt:true, whatsappNumber:{select:{id:true,phoneNumber:true,displayPhoneNumber:true}}}, orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}}) — never selects keyHash. POST session-guarded, zod body {name: z.string().min(1), numberId: z.string().min(1)} -> 400 on failure; verify number prisma.whatsAppNumber.findFirst({where:{id:numberId, userId:session.user.id, verificationStatus:'verified'}}) -> 400 'Invalid or unverified WhatsApp number'; const {plaintext,hash,prefix} = generateApiKey(); const created = await prisma.apiKey.create({data:{userId:session.user.id, whatsappNumberId:numberId, name, keyHash:hash, keyPrefix:prefix}, select:{id:true,name:true,keyPrefix:true,whatsappNumberId:true,lastUsedAt:true,revokedAt:true,createdAt:true}}); return NextResponse.json({...created, key: plaintext}, {status:201}) — the one-time reveal; never store or re-return plaintext. Outer try/catch -> 500. Never log plaintext/hash.

Create src/app/api/api-keys/[id]/route.ts (DELETE) per design.md §6.3: session-guarded; const existing = await prisma.apiKey.findFirst({where:{id:params.id, userId:session.user.id}}); if(!existing) return 404 {error:'Not found'} (cross-user -> 404); if(existing.revokedAt) return NextResponse.json({id:existing.id, revoked:true}) (idempotent); await prisma.apiKey.update({where:{id:existing.id}, data:{revokedAt:new Date()}}); return {id:existing.id, revoked:true}.

Create src/app/dashboard/api-keys/page.tsx per design.md §6.4: 'use client' page matching src/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx conventions (max-w-3xl mx-auto, @/components/ui/{card,button,input,label,badge}, lucide-react icons). On mount GET /api/api-keys -> responsive card list per key (name, keyPrefix, bound number displayPhoneNumber ?? phoneNumber, lastUsedAt, Active/Revoked Badge). Create form: name Input + a <select> of verified numbers from GET /api/numbers filtered to verificationStatus==='verified'; on submit POST /api/api-keys; on success show the one-time plaintext `key` in a highlighted callout with a Copy button and the warning 'Copy this key now. For your security it will not be shown again.', clear it from state on dismiss. Revoke button per active key -> DELETE /api/api-keys/{id} with a confirm, then refresh. Single-column stacking on small screens, consistent with settings.

Edit src/components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx: import KeyRound from lucide-react and add { name: 'API Keys', href: '/dashboard/api-keys', icon: KeyRound } to the navigation array (e.g. after Templates). It inherits the existing active-state and mobile-drawer behavior.

Edit src/app/docs/page.tsx per design.md §7: add a new section 'Connect a third-party application (Server-to-server API)' with a matching toc entry, covering key creation in the dashboard, the Authorization: Bearer wa_live_xxx scheme, the zero-Meta-credential/zero-number guarantee (key bound server-side), per-owner scoping, the three endpoints (method/path/auth/body/success + real codes 401/400/402/404/500 as enumerated in §7), and curl examples via the existing CodeBlock helper (POST /api/v1/messages with {recipient, templateName, variables}, GET /api/v1/messages/MESSAGE_ID, GET /api/v1/templates?status=approved). Correct the stale 'no programmatic API-key scheme' callout in the api-reference section (around lines 476-484) so it states cookie routes are for the dashboard UI while /api/v1 is the integration path for third-party servers (FR5.3).

Edit scratchpad.md: document the new backend endpoints (/api/v1/* and /api/api-keys/*), the ApiKey model + migration, the new lib modules (api-key.ts, api-auth.ts, send-template.ts), the new dashboard page + sidebar link, and the docs change; refresh Last updated and prepend a dated Change log entry (newest first). Do not include any secret values.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build compiles the management routes, the /dashboard/api-keys page, and the edited sidebar + docs page; npm run lint passes (AC18).

POST /api/api-keys returns a wa_live_ plaintext exactly once in a 201 body shaped {id,name,keyPrefix,whatsappNumberId,lastUsedAt,revokedAt,createdAt,key} with no keyHash; the stored row has only keyHash+keyPrefix, no plaintext column (AC3, AC16).
GET /api/api-keys returns the caller's keys scoped to session.user.id with no keyHash and no plaintext; POST rejects a non-verified/non-owned numberId with 400 (AC4, AC5).
DELETE /api/api-keys/{id} sets revokedAt and is idempotent; a key owned by another user returns 404 and is never revocable (AC13, AC14).

The /docs page renders the M2M section documenting the three endpoints, the bearer scheme, the zero-credential guarantee, and number binding, and the stale 'no API-key scheme' note is corrected (AC17, FR5.3).
scratchpad.md reflects the new surfaces and has a dated Change log entry; no secrets are present.
verification: npm run build && npm run lint must pass.

Live key-lifecycle proof: create a key via POST /api/api-keys (or a throwaway script hitting the create logic), confirm plaintext returned once and the DB row stores only keyHash+keyPrefix; authenticate a /api/v1 call with it (200); DELETE to revoke; re-call -> 401. Use a throwaway script against live Turso OR a static trace through the handlers plus the FEAT-001 live-schema check; delete any throwaway after.
Static trace of GET/POST/DELETE /api/api-keys confirming session scoping, one-time reveal shape (no keyHash), and cross-user 404.
grep -rn "wa_live_|keyHash" src across the management routes and the page to confirm no plaintext/hash is logged (AC16); visually confirm the docs section and corrected note render.
findings:
COMPLETED. Files created: src/app/api/api-keys/route.ts (GET list + POST create), src/app/api/api-keys/[id]/route.ts (DELETE revoke). Files edited: src/components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx (KeyRound 'API Keys' nav item after Templates), src/app/docs/page.tsx (new section 6 'Connect a third-party application (Server-to-server API)' + TOC entry, later sections renumbered 7-11, stale 'no programmatic API-key scheme' callout corrected), scratchpad.md (backend table rows for /api/api-keys/*, ApiKey schema row, management + dashboard-page subsections, Last updated 2026-10-18, dated change-log entry newest-first). New page: src/app/dashboard/api-keys/page.tsx.

--- Management route shapes (session auth only) ---
GET /api/api-keys: 401 if no session; else prisma.apiKey.findMany({where:{userId:session.user.id}, select:{id,name,keyPrefix,lastUsedAt,revokedAt,createdAt, whatsappNumber:{select:{id,phoneNumber,displayPhoneNumber}}}, orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}}). keyHash NEVER selected.
POST /api/api-keys: zod {name:min(1), numberId:min(1)} -> 400 on parse fail (first zod message). Number verify prisma.whatsAppNumber.findFirst({id,userId,verificationStatus:'verified'}) -> 400 'Invalid or unverified WhatsApp number'. generateApiKey() -> create stores keyHash+keyPrefix only (select omits keyHash). 201 body = {id,name,keyPrefix,whatsappNumberId,lastUsedAt,revokedAt,createdAt, key:plaintext} -- the ONE-TIME reveal, key never stored/re-returned/logged. Outer try/catch -> 500.
DELETE /api/api-keys/[id]: 401 if no session; findFirst scoped to {id:params.id, userId:session.user.id}; absent/other-user -> 404 {error:'Not found'} (never cross-user revocable); existing.revokedAt set -> idempotent 200 {id,revoked:true}; else update revokedAt=new Date(), 200 {id,revoked:true}. Outer catch -> 500.

--- Dashboard page ---
src/app/dashboard/api-keys/page.tsx ('use client') modelled on settings/page.tsx (max-w-3xl mx-auto, @/components/ui/{card,button,input,label,badge}, lucide KeyRound/Copy/Check/Trash2/ShieldAlert). On mount GET /api/api-keys (list) + GET /api/numbers filtered verificationStatus==='verified' for the create <select>. Create -> POST; success shows plaintext 'key' once in an amber callout with Copy button + warning 'Copy this key now. For your security it will not be shown again.', cleared on dismiss. Per-active-key Revoke (window.confirm) -> DELETE then refresh. grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 form; flex-col sm:flex-row stacking. Native <select> styled with the ui/input class string (no new Select primitive, consistent with repo).

npm run build (prisma generate && next build) -> exit 0; /dashboard/api-keys listed (5.97 kB), /api/v1/* + management routes compile. npm run lint still cannot run in this environment (pre-existing, documented in FEAT-001/002: project ships no ESLint config, so `next lint` hangs on its interactive config prompt); the lint pass inside next build ('Linting and checking validity of types') passed. Live key-lifecycle proof via a throwaway @libsql/client script against live Turso (now DELETED, throwaway ApiKey row cleaned up): (1) create -> plaintext 'wa_live_...' len 51 returned once; (2) stored row columns = id,userId,whatsappNumberId,name,keyPrefix,keyHash,lastUsedAt,revokedAt,createdAt,updatedAt -> stores keyHash+keyPrefix, NO plaintext/secret/key column; (3) authenticate(plaintext) resolves to the owner userId (==200); (4) revoke sets revokedAt; (5) re-authenticate -> null (==401). LIFECYCLE PROOF: PASS. grep -rn 'wa_live_|keyHash' src -> only docs placeholders (wa_live_xxx), the PREFIX constant (api-key.ts), keyHash as a Prisma data/where/compare field (api-keys route + api-auth) and comments; no console logging of any plaintext/hash.
